body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> Although it has been over 50 years since YAMAHA started its guitar business, YAMAHA has recently refocused the guitar business. Currently, the guitar business holds 20%~25% of YAMAHA USA business while keyboard and piano business still remains the principal business of YAMAHA USA. If you visit CES 2006, you will see a separate section for YAMAHA guitars, and listen to the live tunes of Jodee Frawlee, the guitarist as well as YAMAHA staff on the spot. She said that YAMAHA guitars are just amazing craftsmanship.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
